_about: Tool surface of the broker's remote MCP server. REST mirrors these one-to-one under /v1. Every spending tool goes through the ledger's quote -> hold -> capture/release flow and the calling agent key's caps.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Curated models with type, durations, aspect ratios and current credit price per lane.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Exact credit and USD price for a generation before running it. Returns a quote_id valid for 10 minutes.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Run a generation. Accepts a quote_id or model+params. Fails without spending if over the key's per-job or monthly cap.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status, outputs (signed URLs), and the receipt: provider, seconds, credits captured or released.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued job and release its hold.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Get a presigned upload URL for a reference image or video; returns media_id.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: Workflows the account owns, with triggers and estimated credits per run.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Run a workflow now. Pre-quotes all steps and holds the total.

tools.name: create_workflow
tools.description: Create a workflow from a template or a step list. Created disabled until a human enables it in the app, unless the key has the workflows:enable scope.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Available credits, open holds, rollover, and this key's month-to-date spend vs its cap.

tools.name: list_library
tools.description: Search past outputs by text, model, date, folder.

tools.name: store_list_products
tools.description: Products from the connected Shopify/WooCommerce store, for use as workflow inputs.

tools.name: request_topup_link
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout link for a human to pay. Agents cannot purchase directly.
